correctness.rationale: The exact neighborhood update is derived for all n≥1 and all boundary populations. Three exhaustive inequalities in c+s and c prove F^4=F², classify all periodic states and the full attraction basin. Binomial symmetry, Vandermonde convolution and Stirling expansions establish exact counts and asymptotic rates. Explicit-neighbor verification checks 349,524 labelled configurations through n=9 and weighted population counts through n=150; finite checks only corroborate the universal algebraic argument.

value.rationale: A natural highly connected split network has exponentially many primitive two-cycles in even sizes but one in odd sizes, yet an asymptotic oscillation attraction probability exactly 1/4 for both. Explicit opposite-sign sqrt(n) corrections, full basin characterization and sharp second-update period cutoff are structural invariants of this infinite family, not routine renaming of the universal period-two bound.
